 Charlotte Hornets We are inching closer to tip-off between the Charlotte Hornets and the Philadelphia 76ers on Halloween night, and both teams will be a shell of themselves with multiple starters ruled out on each side. 
--> We are inching closer to tip-off between the Charlotte Hornets and the Philadelphia 76ers on Halloween night, and both teams will be a shell of themselves with multiple starters ruled out on each side. 
 The Hornets will once again be without Coby White and Kon Knueppel while the Sixers are resting LeBron James and Joel Embiid on the second night of a back-to-back.
--> The Hornets will once again be without Coby White and Kon Knueppel while the Sixers are resting LeBron James and Joel Embiid on the second night of a back-to-back.
 Charlotte Hornets
--> Charlotte Hornets
